messages:
lily: Hi all — first day setup snag. Installed node 18 via asdf on my M2, but `npm install` bombs during a native module compile: node-gyp can't find OpenSSL headers. Also when I try to git clone through our bastion host I get asked for my key passphrase every time (agent forwarding not working). Any quick checklists?

omar: Welcome! Two separate things but common on macs. For node-gyp you usually need the brew OpenSSL dev files and env vars during build. Which macOS version are you on?

lily: macOS 13.6. Error output: "gyp ERR! stack Error: Can't find OpenSSL include directory" and then many lines.

omar: Ok. Rough checklist that works for me on Apple Silicon:
```bash
# install libs
brew install openssl@1.1 pkg-config
# make sure brew tools are first
export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"
# tell native build where to look
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/lib/pkgconfig"
export LDFLAGS="-L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/lib"
export CPPFLAGS="-I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/include"
# then reinstall native deps
rm -rf node_modules && npm ci
# if using asdf, reshim after changing node versions
asdf reshim nodejs
```
That usually unblocks node-gyp.

kat: Add to that: ensure your shell files source asdf before npm stuff runs (CI/local shells). I put this in ~/.zprofile so GUI apps/Terminal see it: `export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"` then source `~/.asdf/asdf.sh`. If you use direnv for project envs, add the exports in the project .envrc instead of global.

lily: thanks! Now SSH: I ssh to bastion then hop to private host and git prompts me. I tried `ssh -A` but still sees no agent.

kat: For hopping we prefer ProxyJump + ForwardAgent. Example ~/.ssh/config snippet we use internally (replace hostnames):
```text
Host bastion
  HostName bastion.example.com
  User youruser
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
  AddKeysToAgent yes
  UseKeychain yes

Host internal-*
  ProxyJump bastion
  ForwardAgent yes
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
```
Then add key to keychain once: `ssh-add --apple-use-keychain ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` and confirm `ssh -A bastion ssh -T git@github.com` to test forwarding.

omar: If you're still seeing passphrase prompts for git over HTTPS, switch to SSH or set the macOS credential helper: `git config --global credential.helper osxkeychain`. If you have multiple gits (system vs brew) make sure `which git` points to the brew one we recommend.

lily: done, followups: where do I put REPO_TOKEN / REDWOOD_DEV env vars and do we have a canonical dotfiles repo?

kat: Put persistent secrets in ~/.zprofile (we don't commit secrets). We have a starter dotfiles repo `org/dotfiles-starter` with a setup script. I'll DM you the link and add your GitHub handle to the repo team so you can clone. For local-only tokens, consider direnv or the macOS Keychain and use a loader script in your zprofile.

lily: big help, thanks both. I got npm ci to finish after exports and hops work via ProxyJump + keychain. I'll push a tiny note to the dotfiles PR if I tidy my zprofile.
